content_of_post_to_comment:
hello guys
I’m a very quiet person in general that’s what people say about me
but my problem is that when I discuss things with people anything literally anything for example a movie or a book or even religious beliefs… etc
I get to heated when someone disagree with me or when i want to prove my point ! My voice starts to get louder like i’m yelling, i interrupt people when they are speaking , i get mad sometimes i cuss and i know i’m not angry at the person or even feel mad at them after the discussion ends! I even start talking and laughing like nothing happened, no hard feelings at all.
And i don’t really like this about me
Why am i like this ? Why do i care so much to win an argument?
I can see that sometimes people try to avoid discussing anything with me because of my behaviour
How to solve this problem?
Is it something psychological?
Sorry for my bad English😂
comment: The fact that you’re laughing and feeling normal right after the argument is actually interesting. It sounds less like you hate people disagreeing and more like your brain treats disagreement as a challenge you have to win in the moment. I’ve seen this happen when someone ties being wrong to feeling embarrassed or dismissed. Try practicing staying curious when someone disagrees: ask “why do you see it that way?” before defending your own point. Winning a conversation usually matters less than keeping people comfortable enough to have one with you.
